about: What each measured Octatrack module adds to the longest frame interrupt of a reading, in percent of a frame: `first` for one alone on the Part (its first track or slot there, with what waking it from rest adds), `each` for every further one. The site sends this table with every module set (MWMS v2, sdk/runtime/loader/set_package.h, as use = each and wake = first - each); the base judges every module pick by the longest frame it would play, or a full stock load (mw_stock_reserve) with the Part's modules on top when that is more, against mw_frame_line (status.c). `stock`, the base's own figures in percent of a frame, takes the compiled ones' place: the reserve a full stock Part keeps (`reserve`), the share one sample track takes, which a machine in its place gives back (`trackStock`), and the line no pick may reach (`line`). A module not listed: a machine is charged its measured meter cost or its price (12 % when it names none) a track, an effect nothing, and either 3 % more when it wakes from rest. Measure with `npm run device:price` on a unit: c(n), the longest frame's rise over 8 s with n = 1 to 4 of the module on empty tracks or slots of a busy pattern (on a track that plays a sample a machine saves that render and reads low). `each` is the steepest step from the third on, max(c3 - c2, c4 - c3); `first` the least that covers every reading with it, the most of c(n) - (n - 1) * each. With one reading only, `first` and `each` are both c(1). Prefer a reading on the newest base. A negative reading counts 0. Base-owned: a module's own folder never changes for it.
